name: Old Tern
text: Fly South. When this comes home: so do your Birds that missed a fight.
golden_text: Fly South. When this comes home: so do your Birds that missed a fight.
details: Only Birds that have missed a fight can be recalled early. Each homecoming doubles once; it returns to hand.
golden_details: Trips last 1 turn. Only Birds that have missed a fight can be recalled early; each doubles once.
